B_TARGET_VARIABLE.name: waiting_time_minutes
B_TARGET_VARIABLE.description: Patient actual waiting time before consultation in minutes

C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.waiting_time_minutes: TARGET VARIABLE - must not be in X
C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.patient_id: Unique identifier with no predictive value; causes overfitting
C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.previous_patient_service_time: LEAKAGE - outcome from previous patient after current patient joins queue
C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.visit_date: Temporal feature; use day_of_week as proxy; requires date parsing
C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.arrival_time: Temporal feature; requires HH:MM parsing; use peak_hour instead
C_FEATURES_EXCLUDED.scheduled_time: Temporal feature; requires HH:MM parsing; arrival_delay_minutes captures the diff

numerical_features.scaling: NOT applied (suitable for tree-based models; add StandardScaler if using linear models)

D_PREPROCESSING_STRATEGY.pipeline: sklearn ColumnTransformer combining numerical and categorical transformers

average_service_time_minutes.assumption: This value represents historical average per doctor, computed from data BEFORE this patient arrived
average_service_time_minutes.risk: HIGH if calculated using entire dataset including future patients; SAFE if from historical records only
average_service_time_minutes.usage: Assume this is pre-calculated from historical queue records; not recalculated on test set
average_service_time_minutes.note: In production, this should be updated daily/weekly from past data, not recomputed on current queue

previous_patient_service_time.reason: This is outcome from PREVIOUS patient; becomes known AFTER current patient joins queue but BEFORE prediction
previous_patient_service_time.impact: Would create look-ahead bias if included; not available at prediction time

prediction_point.timing: Immediately after patient joins queue and is assigned a token
prediction_point.available_info: Patient demographics, queue state at arrival, doctor info, time-of-day, hospital operational status
prediction_point.unavailable_info: Actual service time (outcome), previous patient details, future queue changes

I_DATA_QUALITY_CHECKS.no_nan_in_transformed_data: Train NaN count=0, Test NaN count=0 ✓
